notes.title: SEASON 2 IS LIVE NOW
notes.notes:
Circle of Sumo: Online Rumble Season 2  is out now, 
In this new season we're introducing new Sumo Wrestlers of different sizes, new arenas that will leave you stunned and new emotes to taunt your opponents in 21 new unique ways.

Jump into Season 2 and be ready to experience Sumo in a totally unexpected and hilarious way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101366/295e0adce0fe0bbb5f3cbb0d9e351a0b03a4dea5.png[/img]


[b]Four new arenas![/b]
Season 2 will come with some of the trickiest Sumo arenas ever created. Snipers who love to watch Sumo matches, trains that are oddly on time, a Golf hole that I suggest you to avoid, and the busiest roundabout in the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101366/2aa1ef40e6c851fe3be47eb0f529a92dded6238f.png[/img]

[b]Railway[/b]
A rotating platform and cargo trains will put your positioning to the test. I wonder if it's possible to dodge a train, maybe with the right timing...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101366/ddcd6247e5dea806badf71d591faf22016092b79.png[/img]

[b]Golf[/b]
While playing on this map you can feel your bare foot touching the perfectly cut putting grass. Despite this, it's not a relaxing experience. A golf cart will try to push you out of the not-so-circular arena and remember it's Sumo, not Golf. Stay away from the hole!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101366/1b726b8b5c680cbed7970694cd51b25ee1203368.png[/img]

[b]Gun Sight[/b]
World's deadliest sniper has a contract to complete, sadly he has only one weakness, and it's Sumo!
The sniper wants to see some Sumo Wrestlers fight, stay in his sight and he will proclaim you the winner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101366/2a7ea405a117dc31ca2c5e589b48f2950dae5794.png[/img]

[b]Roundabout[/b]
No one likes crowded traffic circles, both entering and exiting them can be a problem. We created the busiest roundabout ever, the cars can be your salvation or your doom, keep that in mind!

[b]4 new Sumo Wrestlers[/b]
We created four new Sumotoris quite different from what you are used to. These new champs have different sizes, some are small, and others are extra-large! This introduces a new mechanic to the gameplay, we can't wait to see how you will use them!
A new meta is coming?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101366/127fa912cea136c638aec30dff435c2f43b3acec.png[/img]

[b]21 new emotes[/b]
From now you can find new emotes in the Takarabakos! Twentyone new different ways to express your emotions and taunt your enemies. In Sumo the respect of the opponent is important, but don't forget to have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101366/a8d15308acbcbf3e5ddf2ed368cb48f5eb89daf4.png[/img]

[b]Last but not least: IMPORTANT NOTES![/b]
We introduced a weekly pool of Sumo wrestlers and arenas so that, when using the "random" option to select them, only those part of the pool and those already unlocked will be eligible to be picked. Every Monday the pool will change, so you will be able to try all the content for free!

We also reset all the rankings and the medals, a new start for everyone!

That's all, have fun with all the new content!

notes.title: Season 1 Recap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101366/b107a2aa16f2d424edfa3e755b5c874a24d26145.png[/img]

[h1]Season 1 Recap[/h1]
[b]Welcome back[/b] Sumo Wrestlers!
As you may know, [b]Season 2 will be out [b]tomorrow[/b]!
[/b]But today we look back to [b]how amazing Season 1 was.[/b]

Circle of Sumo is our[b] first Online Multiplayer game[/b]. 
When we started we didn't have a clear idea of where this journey would take us.
But now, one year after the first release in Early access, here we are, [b]ready for the next step[/b]!

We have to [b]thank[/b] all the [b]people[/b] who[b] played[/b] Circle of Sumo, and the ones who are[b] still [/b][b]playing[/b] it after a year, you are awsome!
A [b]special[/b] thanks go to[b] Mauss[/b] and [b]Tekeden:[/b] the[b] best[/b] Discord Server [b]moderators[/b] we could ever dream of, and amazing [b]organizers[/b] of all the[b] Community Tournaments[/b] too. Thanks also to all the Sumotoris who joined these tournaments!

[h3]Now some numbers from Season 1![/h3]

More than [b]190'000 players[/b] have fought on the COSOR's arenas (190.355 to date), coming from 175 different countries.  

Only 0,02% of the players ever reached the Yokozuna rank, the highest on the leaderboard. As of today, there are only [b]2 Yokozunas[/b]: [b]Shang[/b] and [b]Tekeden[/b] - congrats guys!

The [b]top 10 players[/b] of the game played an astonishing [b]25575 1v1 matches[/b] and [b]5420 FFA matches![/b]
We can surely say the[b] 1vs1[/b] mode is the[b] favorite[/b] one from the[b] pro players[/b] of Circle of Sumo: Online Rumble!

An honourable mention goes to [b]Shang[/b], he's the person with the [b]most played matches[/b] and the current nr.1 player in the world ranking. He's the one to beat!

With the last update, we introduced [b] Heyas[/b]. Heyas are the clans of COS:OR!.
Right now there are[b] 1544 active Heyas[/b], a few more than we were expecting!

So thanks for your support, we are very grateful to those who left a review on the game!


[h3]Friendly reminder
[/h3][b]Tomorrow[/b] we will [b]reset[/b] the [b]rankings [/b]and the [b]medals[/b], in order to allow everyone to have a [b]fresh start![/b]
Have fun!

[h3]Hi, fellow sumotoris!

We received a lot of feedback regarding our ranking system and its balancing. Thanks to it, [b]we developed a new version of our system[/b].

notes.title: ISSUES ON MATCHMAKING WHILE IN PARTY
notes.notes:
Hi Sumotoris!

It's never easy to admit it but yes, we are experiencing some issues with matchmaking while in parties with friends. We are working really hard to solve this problem and we apology. But have faith, we will be on top of it soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101366/38405a59325ee99498df8f8d039f7097dbe24d6e.gif[/img]

[h2][b]HOW IT SHOULD WORK[/b] 
[/h2]It's pretty easy, when you are in a party and everyone is ready, the matchmaking checks how many of you are there. If less than 4 it looks for single players to match with you and then starts (with or without other players), if you are already 4 players it immediately starts.

[h2][b]KNOW ISSUES[/b]
[/h2] In some cases, the system doesn't work and the party it's not able to start any match. Here is some know issues about this problem:
[list]
[*] The party doesn't start any match and the wait keeps going on forever
[*] Some players of the party join a match, others get stuck on idle in the waiting room
[*] Some players are not able to join a party
[/list]

[h2][b]WHAT TO DO?[/b][/h2]
You can try one or all of these solutions that seems to work in some cases. 
[list]
[*] Quit the party (all players) and re-create it
[*] Change the player who is inviting others to the party. If you are inviting a friend, let that friend invite you.
[*] Restart the game and re-create the party
[*] Press F to pay respect
[/list]
We will keep you posted on any new update on the issue! Feel free to leave a comment with feedback or send an in-game report with F7.

Thanks so much for the patient, you guys are awesome!

notes.title: PLAY AGAINST YOUR FRIENDS! - New Update
notes.notes:
Hey Sumotoris!
We have a big announcement for you!

From the beginning of the Early Access here on Steam, you all asked for the same, very important feature.
We have listened to you!
Our dev team has worked like crazy in the past few months to bring this update to you and finally today we are proud to announce that YOU CAN NOW INVITE YOUR FRIENDS and play against them in Circle of Sumo: Online Rumble!

How does it work?
Well, we redesigned the game's menu a bit.
You will now see your party at the bottom of the screen. 
If you click on the friends list button or on the boxes with the plus symbol, you can invite your friends for parties up to 4 players.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/RiWmEvssyX9nbuAc7Y/giphy.gif[/img]

At any time you can click on the play button and choose a sumo wrestler and an arena!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Y1vEzVSPbf97r74OwH/giphy.gif[/img]

Once all this is done, you can choose between game modes. If you are in a party, you can only go for the free-for-all mode. When all the players have selected both sumotori and arena, they are flagged as ready and the party leader can start the matchmaking!
Don't worry if your party is not made up of 4 players, the game will match you with random players from the internet. No random players from the internet? The game will start with just your friends!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/QaHOuY6kSqnAnSgvlA/giphy.gif[/img]

That's all for the first sumo-tutorial, now you are ready to challenge your friends in Circle of Sumo: Online Rumble!

[previewyoutube=FhsAfE6vq1o;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Oh, one last thing![/b]
We made another important change, and it's about the defeat condition.
Many of you noticed that sometimes, even if an opponent was thrown out of the arena before you, you could lose the round. That was because maybe the other player was still "flying" across the map and, until the animation kicked in, they were still considered in play. 
Well, we fixed that! Now the player will be considered defeated as soon they are outside of the ring.


[b]Here we go with the full CHANGELOG:[/b]
1.3.7
[list]
[*]Added Play With Friends and party management functionalities.
[*]Added Unranked FFA game mode with Play With Friends and variable player count support.
Removed Ranked FFA.
[*]Moved the selection of the game mode after the selection of the sumotori and the arena to better support Play With Friends.
[*]Changed defeat condition: a player is considered defeated as soon as they are outside of the ring instead of waiting for them to slow down and perform the defeat animation.
[*]Decreased charge times for all the sumotoris.
[*]Added buttons to the Banzuke to jump to the first positions and to the player’s position.
[*]Saved emotes key-mappings on the servers. They won’t be lost anymore when using a different device to play the game.
[*]Fixed video options showing only a couple of incorrect resolutions.
[*]Fixed player names with curly braces causing exceptions to be thrown.
[*]Disabled multiple cursors support as it was no longer necessary.
[*]Updated Rewired to solve a bug related to Steam and focus changing.
[*]Fixed the charge bar not emptying when a player cancels their charge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101366/d352f42e31a4f671e899783d2f916097290b8616.png[/img]

[b]Q.[/b] How do I register for the tournament?
[b]A.[/b] You have to register on the Google form down below. 

[b]Q.[/b] I’m new to the game, can I still register?
[b]A.[/b] Yes, absolutely! We are going to organize the brackets in a way that will allow new players to play other new players, at least in the first few rounds. This way, even you can enjoy the tournament!

[b]Q.[/b] When does the tournament start?⏳
[b]A.[/b] The tournament will start Thursday, April 9th. Therefore, the limit date to register is Wednesday, April 8th (CET timezone). The matches are going to take place every Thursdays and Sundays for a few weeks. All the matches are going to be streamed🗣️🗣️

[b]Q. [/b]What if me or my opponent are not available on Thursdays and Sundays?
[b]A.[/b] In that case, you and your opponent will decide together on a day and time you are both available to play. You will then DM an @Event Organizer on our Discord server and ask them to assist in your match on the given day. If that happens, your match will not be streamed. 

[b]Q.[/b] What is the format of the tournament? 
[b]A. [/b]The tournament is going to follow the single-elimination format. The matches are going to be Best-of-3, except for the Quarter-finals, Semi-finals and Final, which are going to be Best-of-5.

[b]Q.[/b] Is there going to be a loser bracket?
[b]A.[/b] No.

[b]Q.[/b] How is the tournament going to take place if we can’t choose who we’re playing against?
[b]A.[/b] We will create a new branch on steam with a password that we will give to the players involved in the match. Then, the two players will join a match with an organizer. We will change the password for every match so that only the involved players can join.

[b]Q.[/b] What if I did not buy the premium pack?
[b]A.[/b] Do not worry. We want this tournament to be fair. Therefore, everyone during the tournament will have to choose a random map, even those that have bought the premium pack. However, players that bought the premium pack are going to be able to choose their character, as it would be too disorienting for players used to a certain character. 

[b]Q.[/b] Are there prizes to win? :trophy:
[b]A.[/b] Yes! We have gift cards for the finalists, as well as in-game prizes for people making it to the Quarter-finals, Semi-finals and the Final!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101366/a8663a6eda30a29f49d4cb54f4ea6503b84ab0cd.png[/img]

Make sure to read the following rules before your matches!

[b](1)[/b] Softwares that can improve your performance are prohibited. 

[b](2)[/b] You have to register to the tournament on the Google form below before the 8th of April (CET timezone). 

[b](3) [/b]The matches are Best-of-3 and single-elimination: you win your match if you win two games. Quarter-finals, Semi-finals and the Final are Best-of-5: you win your match if you win three games. 

[b](4)[/b] You have to choose a random map (no map-pick) :map:

[b](5)[/b] You can choose your character if you have any. 

[b](6)[/b] You have to be punctual: you will have a date and an approximate time for your match. You will need to be ready on the given date and time. If you keep us waiting, you will be disqualified:stopwatch: 

[b](7)[/b] If you are not available to play on Thursdays and Sundays (the days we stream the matches), please, contact an @Event Organizer on our Discord server to let them know. We will try to find a day and time you and your opponent are available. 

[b](8)[/b] If your controller disconnects or if you get disconnected during a match, the event organizer might allow a rematch 🎮

notes.title: CHANGELOG #4 - 1.2.1
notes.notes:
A new Sumo-Update is now online!

Let's start from the [b]Takarabakos[/b] (The boxes), we added a new one!
You can now find Champions and Arenas when you open this new Takarabako.
Yes, even if you don't have the DLC!
The DLC is still the fastest way to have all the players and the arenas selectable.

We have another interesting change, [b]we redesigned the Tower level[/b]!
As you know a lot of players like to camp on the tower merlons, but thanks to your feedback
we decided to say no to camping-sumo and now you can't just stand near a merlon. 

Why? 
Because...you know, you are a bit out of shape, and now the merlons are round, the result will be just you sliding and sweating on the brand new convex merlon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101366/59ecb7b509d819c37d784099d47ec3b241411e18.png[/img]


[b]Gamepad-friendly[/b]

A lot of players told us that Mouse is a better way to play Circle of Sumo thanks to the aiming system.
Well, we added a cursor showing the direction the player is charging also if you are playing with a gamepad.
We are for equal rights for keyboard-mouse and gamepad users <3

We decided to implement the [b]rankings into the matchmaking system[/b]. You will now be able to match players with abilities similar to yours. 
No one is at your level? 
No worries, if no matches are found in a reasonably short amount of time, the system will ignore the skill constraints.

Want to know another thing you can do faster? [b]Counter-move[/b]!
We reduced the preparation time of the counter-move to make it fast as the dodge.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36101366/f21de83b1aae96cfd962f3cb657807583ce1d7b7.jpg[/img]

[b]Floating names[/b] on the Sumotoris head
At the beginning of every match, you will see your name and respective of the other sumotoris.
Now you can rapidly find out who is your worst enemies, or your friend...who knows?

[b]Fixes and changes[/b], the full list of what's new in this update ( You should not read this)

[list]
[*] Added a new Takarabako containing players and arenas.
[*] Changed the map ‘Tower’ to have convex crenellations that should prevent excessively defensive strategies.
[*] Modified the skill calculation algorithm to be fairer and more consistent.
[*] Modified the skill ranges of the ranks to better reflect the ability level of the players.
[*] Added numbers to the skill ranks’ names to make their order clearer.
[*] Added skill-based matchmaking. If no matches are found in a reasonably short amount of time, the system will ignore the skill constraints.
[*] Added players’ names on top of each character at the beginning of each round.
[*] Added a cursor showing the direction the player is charging towards when a gamepad is used.
[*] Reduced the preparation time of the counter-move to make it as fast as the dodge.
[*] Changed ‘cancel’ into ‘ok’ in the message signalling that the player does not have enough money to purchase a Takarabako.
[*] Added buttons to access the store/items collection from every screen and fixed its transition animation.
[*] Added coins panel to every screen.
[*] Added message to indicate that the game does not support versions of Windows below Windows 10.
[*] Fixed video options panel not showing some resolutions when using them.
[*] Fixed the button to open a Takarabako remaining active when the player doesn’t have enough money and a message is shown.
[*] Fixed NullReferenceException in Quantum.Entity.GetTransform2D (Quantum.ShockwaveSystem.ProcessShockwaves).
[*] Fixed NullReferenceException in UIPopup.Show.
[*] Fixed UIScoreboard.TryFetchingAgain not working when fetching the backend data fails.
[*] Fixed the emote binding screen not always processing clicks.
[*] Fixed NullReferenceException in LocalInput.Update when quitting a match.
[*] Fixed the bug reported not always working during matches.
[*] Mitigated connection drops during matches with high latency.
[/list]


And thaaaaat's all for now!
Enjoy the update, see you in the Arenas!
